build_bigearthnet_dataset: build a BigEarthNet dataset builder with rgb or all Sentinel-2 channel selection
create_bigearthnet_config: create a BigEarthNet builder config with rgb or all band selection option
read_bigearthnet_archive: read a BigEarthNet tar archive and extract band files and metadata for each patch
process_bigearthnet_example: process a BigEarthNet example by loading tif bands and extracting labels from metadata
create_rgb_image: create an RGB image from Sentinel-2 B02, B03, B04 bands by rescaling and clipping pixel values
